en.headline: Salt-water pipe burst floods Kwai Fong motorcycle bays
en.dek: Muddy water soaked parked bikes on Wing Fong Road on Wednesday night after a short supply cut.
body: A burst salt-water pipe sent muddy water across motorcycle parking bays on Wing Fong Road in Kwai Fong on Wednesday night.

The leak began at about 10pm near Shing Fong Street, Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao Daily reported. Yellow, sediment-laden water spread along the kerbside bays, soaking the wheels of several parked motorcycles. The reports did not say any bike had fallen.

Police attended, confirmed the failed pipe carried salt water, and called the Water Supplies Department. Sing Tao Daily, citing the department’s online record, said salt-water supply in the area was suspended at 10.36pm and restored at 11.08pm, an interruption of about 32 minutes. The department noted that the actual restoration time could still shift with repair progress.

zh.headline: 葵芳榮芳路鹹水管爆裂 電單車泊位湧黃泥水
zh.dek: 周三約晚上10時盛芳街一帶地底鹹水管爆裂，水務署暫停供應約32分鐘。
body: 葵芳榮芳路近盛芳街周三晚有地底鹹水管爆裂，黃泥水湧上電單車泊位。
《香港01》及《星島日報》報道，事發於約晚上10時。混雜泥沙的水沿路旁俗稱「骨位」的電單車泊位流過，多輛停泊電單車的車輪被浸着。報道沒有指有電單車翻側。
警方到場後證實爆裂的是鹹水管，並通知水務署跟進。《星島日報》引述水務署網上紀錄稱，現場一帶鹹水供應於晚上10時36分緊急暫停，至11時08分恢復，停水約32分鐘。水務署提醒，實際恢復時間或會因維修進度而調整。
